utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?
Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.
Ah, I see. Since you're here, I wanted to show you how to hold the crochet hook properly.
I'm glad you're learning new things. Crocheting can be so relaxing once you get the rhythm.
Thanks, Grandma! I haven't tried crocheting yet, but it sounds fun. Maybe you can teach me the basic stitches now?
That sounds wonderful! I'm so proud of you for wanting to start a project. I'd love to help you with it.
Thanks, Grandma! I'd love to start a small scarf. Maybe we can have a little crafting session together this afternoon?
Oh, I'd love that. Just let me know when you've picked out your favorite yarn color.
Great! I'll let you know once I find that soft blue yarn. I'm really excited to learn this from you!
Oh, look at your first few stitches, you're doing it perfectly! Keep going, dear.
Thanks, Grandma! Your support means a lot to me. I can't wait to show you when I finish the first row.
Alright, I'm excited to see how the pattern comes together!
I'm sure you'll love it! I'll keep you updated on my progress as I go.
That's wonderful! I bet your first piece will turn out beautifully. You have such a natural talent for handiwork.
Thank you! I've learned from the best. I'll show you the progress again soon so you can check my tension.
